steering_ledger.verbatim:
The program as weights links seem relevant for constructing agent loops and making our current agent loops more robust. I liek the idea of a GUI for designing high level processes that clearly separate deterministic flow from fuzzy LLM work in a menaingful way. The jev-related links/content seem extremely relevant for the orchestrator where json schemas are passed and tool use is important since it both guarantees exact tool use and also a pretty large overall speed boost. We hsould find a way to fold those techniques into the orchestrator. It may also be relevant for fast routing and episodic memory writing.  

Lastly, the Agentic Kernel Porting seems obviosuly relevant to autokernel
steering_ledger.plan_ref: PLAN-FRAME (to instantiate at Stage 3): (a) Jev typed-decision techniques -> orchestrator JSON-schema/tool-use path, fast routing, episodic-memory writing; (b) PAW -> agent-loop robustness + a GUI separating deterministic flow from fuzzy LLM work; (c) agentic porting methodology -> autokernel (contingent on operator-supplied primary URL; see declines).
